effect_description_eng:
[Security] If your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon, play this card without battling and without paying the cost.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
